Lower Text: [Security] Reveal the top 2 cards of your deck. Add 1 purple or blue card among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck. Then, place this card in the battle area.
Upper Text: While you don't have [Image Training] in the battle area, you can ignore this card's color requirements.
[Main] Reveal the top 2 cards of your deck. Add 1 purple or blue card among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck. Then, place this card in the battle area.
・1 of your Digimon may digivolve into a purple or blue Digimon card in the hand with the digivolution cost reduced by 2.
